newsitem.title: USA: ADVISORY - Chicago exchanges' holiday hours.
newsitem.headline: ADVISORY - Chicago exchanges' holiday hours.

text.p: Chicago's futures and options exchanges said all markets, including GLOBEX and Project A, will be closed on Wednesday, December 25 in observance of the Christmas holiday.
On Tuesday, December 24, the Chicago Board of Trade will shut all markets at 1210 CST/1810 GMT. Project A and night trading will be closed.
At the Chicago Mercantile Exchange, all contracts close at 1200 CST/1800 GMT, except stock index futures, which will end at 1215 CST/1815 GMT on Christmas Eve.

The Chicago Board Options Exchange will end trading in its interest rate options at 1200 CST/1800 GMT. CBOE's equity options will close at 1210 CST/1810 GMT and equity index options will end at 1215 CST/1815 GMT.
